samples.title: QA Automation Engineer
samples.description:
Fabrikam Logistics builds routing software for freight carriers across Europe and the Middle East. Our platform plans several million shipments a year and connects warehouses, drivers and customs brokers through one shared system.

Since the company was founded we have grown from a small team in Haifa to six offices. We believe that reliable software is a form of respect for the people who depend on it, and we invest in the tools, time and training that make careful work possible.

Our engineering group works in small product squads, each owning a part of the platform end to end. Squads choose their own rituals, keep their services running in production, and share what they learn in a weekly open forum that anyone in the company may join.

We offer flexible hours, a learning budget, private health cover and a yearly company week. We are proud of a diverse workplace and we welcome applicants from every background, including people returning to work after a career break.

Requirements:
- 4+ years of hands-on experience writing automated tests for web applications
- Strong TypeScript or JavaScript skills, and experience with Playwright or Cypress
- Experience testing REST APIs and reading service logs to find the cause of a failure
- Experience adding automated suites to CI pipelines such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins
- Good understanding of test design, flaky test diagnosis and test data management
- Good written and spoken English

Nice to have:
- Experience with performance testing tools
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and Docker
- Background in logistics or supply chain products

Responsibilities:
- Own the automated regression suite for the planning product
- Work with developers to design testable features before they are built
- Investigate production incidents and turn them into new automated checks
- Coach other engineers on test strategy and review their test code

samples.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
samples.description:
Examplepay builds payment infrastructure for banks. We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to own end-to-end test coverage.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience in test automation
- Strong TypeScript or JavaScript skills
- Hands-on experience with Playwright or Cypress
- Experience testing REST APIs
- Experience with CI pipelines

Nice to have:
- Experience in fintech
- Familiarity with k6 for load testing

Hybrid: three days a week in our Tel Aviv office.

- חקירת תקלות בייצור והפיכתן לבדיקות אוטומטיות חדשות
